name: Keldooine
description: Keldooine was a planet and shadowport in the Keldooine system on the edge of Hutt Space. During the Republic Era, Keldooine was a key world in the region, though by 33 BBY, the piracy rampant in the Slice had taken hold on the planet. The former pirate Queen Maz Kanata marked it as a point of interest on a map she included in the book that would become known as the Smuggler's Guide.
